headline: Semtech lists cross-site roles for block-to-chip mixed-signal IC verification
fact: Semtech posted related senior verification roles in San Diego and Hyderabad covering verification plans for mixed-signal IP, subsystems, and full ICs; SystemVerilog and UVM testbenches; RTL, gate-level, and AMS simulation; constrained-random stimulus; assertions, functional and code coverage; continuous integration and regression automation; and desired SV-RNM or Verilog behavioral modeling. The San Diego role is tied to low-power sensing ICs with ADCs. These postings evidence a hiring mandate, not completed deployment.

sources.title: Semtech Careers: Sr. Verification Engineer – Mixed-Signal ICs (REQ2930)
sources.summary: The official Workday record describes a San Diego sensing-IC role spanning block/chip AMS, UVM, coverage, CI/regressions, and desired SV-RNM or behavioral modeling; it shows only a mutable relative posting age.

sources.title: Semtech Careers: Sr. Staff Verification Engineer (REQ2988)
sources.summary: The official Workday record describes the corresponding Hyderabad mandate for mixed-signal IP-through-chip verification, UVM, AMS simulation, coverage, automation, and desired analog behavioral modeling.
